summary: Wave 102 retest — backend now fully green (6/6 pytest pass after audit_log + suppliers_pending fixes). Frontend mostly green: Active/Suspended sub-tabs, exact missing-doc names in admin Dealers table, Outreach Analytics dialog with funnel chart + drill-down, /login?next=/supplier magic-link redirect, and 4 of 5 dealer profile dropdown menu items (details, submitted-docs, raise-query with email send + toast, logout) all working. TWO real issues found: (1) profile-menu-missing-docs does NOT open phase2-docs-dialog for impersonated dealers; (2) Phase2Banner does NOT render under impersonation for Amman Gaming Origin even though admin Dealers table correctly shows 'Missing: Cancelled cheque' for the same dealer — likely impersonation pathway is not surfacing the supplier row fields the banner reads.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking dropdown item profile-menu-missing-docs does not open phase2-docs-dialog under impersonation (tested for both Big C and Amman). For Big C this is arguably acceptable since they have no missing docs, but for Amman (missing Cancelled cheque per admin table) the Phase2 docs dialog must open. React also logs 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' when this item is clicked.

Phase2Banner does NOT render on /supplier for Amman Gaming Origin under impersonation, despite admin Dealers table correctly listing 'Missing: Cancelled cheque' for the same dealer. body text contains no 'Cancelled cheque' nudge. Probable root cause: impersonation pathway returns a `user.supplier` payload whose OPTIONAL_DOCS keys (doc_bank_proof etc.) are already populated/null in a way that bypasses the `hasAnyGap` check in Phase2Banner.jsx:86, OR the impersonation user fetch does not return the supplier object the banner expects. Net effect: dealers logging in to their own dashboard get no nudge for the same missing docs admin sees.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' — accessibility nit, add a DialogDescription or aria-describedby.

action_items: Fix Phase2Banner not rendering under impersonation. Check whether impersonate fetch in /api/auth/me (or whatever powers user.supplier) returns the same row admin Dealers uses. Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to outreach-analytics-dialog, profile-details-dialog, profile-submitted-docs-dialog, raise-query-dialog for a11y.

critical_code_review_comments: DealerProfileMenu triggers 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' — likely a setState in an effect/render path that fires when a sibling dialog mounts. Wrap state updates in setTimeout/queueMicrotask or move into onClick of the menu item.

Outreach funnel currently iterates Supabase Auth list_users with up to 50 pages * 1000 users per request — flagged in iteration 75 and still present. Consider caching last_sign_in_at or per-email lookup as scale grows.
Phase2Banner & admin DealersTab compute 'missing docs' independently from the same supplier row — extract a shared util so the two views never diverge.

rca of the issue: Backend audit_log mismatch is fully resolved (insert + read both use `metadata` column; non-existent `target_type` removed). suppliers_pending NOT-NULL bug is also resolved (admin.py no longer pre-inserts a suppliers_pending row in bulk-create — dealer creates it via Phase-1 form). The remaining frontend bugs appear to be in the impersonation render path: SupplierDashboard.jsx:912 conditionally renders Phase2Banner on `isApproved && user?.supplier`. Under impersonation either `isApproved` is false or `user.supplier` is missing the optional-doc keys it needs. DealerProfileMenu's missing-docs click likely toggles state on a Phase2Banner instance that isn't mounted (line 793 banner has hideBanner=true and may not own the dialog state).
